name: Claude Code
description: Anthropic 官方 Agent 编程助手 CLI，支持沙箱内代码全自动探索与工程演进。
installSteps: if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs npm || true; fi

npm_config_prefix="$WANXIANG_TOOL_DIR" npm install -g --ignore-scripts @anthropic-ai/claude-code --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com || npm_config_prefix="$WANXIANG_TOOL_DIR" npm install -g --ignore-scripts @anthropic-ai/claude-code

printf '#!/usr/bin/env sh
MODULE_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../lib/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code" && pwd)"
if [ -f "$MODULE_DIR/cli-wrapper.cjs" ]; then
    exec node "$MODULE_DIR/cli-wrapper.cjs" "$@"
elif [ -f "$MODULE_DIR/cli.js" ]; then
    exec node "$MODULE_DIR/cli.js" "$@"
else
    exec node "$MODULE_DIR/index.js" "$@"
fi
' > "$WANXIANG_TOOL_DIR/bin/claude"

npm_config_prefix="$WANXIANG_TOOL_DIR" npm install -g openclaw --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com || npm_config_prefix="$WANXIANG_TOOL_DIR" npm install -g openclaw || true

name: llama.cpp 本地推理引擎
description: 在 ARM64 Linux 沙箱内运行 GGUF 模型，并提供 OpenAI 兼容的本地推理接口。
installSteps: case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64|arm64) ;; *) echo 'llama.cpp 本地推理仅支持 ARM64/aarch64' >&2; exit 64;; esac

if command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential cmake curl ca-certificates; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then apk add --no-cache build-base cmake curl ca-certificates linux-headers; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then pacman -Sy --noconfirm --needed base-devel cmake curl ca-certificates; elif command -v dnf >/dev/null 2>&1; then dnf install -y gcc-c++ cmake make curl ca-certificates; elif command -v zypper >/dev/null 2>&1; then zypper --non-interactive install gcc-c++ cmake make curl ca-certificates; else echo '当前发行版缺少受支持的包管理器，无法安装 C++ 构建工具链' >&2; exit 65; fi

LLAMA_SOURCE_URL=$(python3 -c 'import json,urllib.request; print(json.load(urllib.request.urlopen("https://api.github.com/repos/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/latest"))["tarball_url"])') && test -n "$LLAMA_SOURCE_URL" && curl --fail --location --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$LLAMA_SOURCE_URL" -o /tmp/wanxiang-llama-cpp-source.tar.gz && rm -rf "$WANXIANG_TOOL_DIR/src/llama.cpp" && mkdir -p "$WANXIANG_TOOL_DIR/src/llama.cpp" && tar -xzf /tmp/wanxiang-llama-cpp-source.tar.gz -C "$WANXIANG_TOOL_DIR/src/llama.cpp" --strip-components=1 && rm -f /tmp/wanxiang-llama-cpp-source.tar.gz
verifyCommand: case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64|arm64) llama-server --version;; *) exit 1;; esac

name: QEMU x86_64 兼容构建环境
description: 可选的 ARM64 QEMU 用户态模拟器与隔离 x86_64 Ubuntu Base RootFS，仅用于第三方项目的兼容构建。
installSteps: case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64|arm64) ;; *) echo 'QEMU 兼容插件宿主仅支持 ARM64' >&2; exit 64;; esac
if ! command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '当前仅支持 Debian/Ubuntu ARM64 RootFS 安装 QEMU 兼容插件' >&2; exit 65; fi

DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends qemu-user-static curl ca-certificates tar gzip unzip xz-utils findutils coreutils

rm -rf /tmp/wanxiang-jdk-x64 "$COMPAT_ROOT/jdk-17"; mkdir -p /tmp/wanxiang-jdk-x64; tar -xzf /tmp/wanxiang-jdk17-x64.tar.gz -C /tmp/wanxiang-jdk-x64; JDK_SOURCE=$(find /tmp/wanxiang-jdk-x64 -type f -path '*/bin/java' -print -quit | xargs -r dirname | xargs -r dirname); test -x "$JDK_SOURCE/bin/java"; mv "$JDK_SOURCE" "$COMPAT_ROOT/jdk-17"; rm -rf /tmp/wanxiang-jdk-x64 /tmp/wanxiang-jdk17-x64.tar.gz

rm -rf /tmp/wanxiang-platform-x64 "$COMPAT_ROOT/android-sdk/platforms/android-34"; mkdir -p /tmp/wanxiang-platform-x64 "$COMPAT_ROOT/android-sdk/platforms"; unzip -q /tmp/wanxiang-platform-34.zip -d /tmp/wanxiang-platform-x64; PLATFORM_SOURCE=$(find /tmp/wanxiang-platform-x64 -type f -name android.jar -print -quit | xargs -r dirname); test -f "$PLATFORM_SOURCE/android.jar"; mv "$PLATFORM_SOURCE" "$COMPAT_ROOT/android-sdk/platforms/android-34"; rm -rf /tmp/wanxiang-platform-x64 /tmp/wanxiang-platform-34.zip

rm -rf /tmp/wanxiang-build-tools-x64 "$COMPAT_ROOT/android-sdk/build-tools/35.0.0"; mkdir -p /tmp/wanxiang-build-tools-x64 "$COMPAT_ROOT/android-sdk/build-tools"; unzip -q /tmp/wanxiang-build-tools-35.zip -d /tmp/wanxiang-build-tools-x64; BUILD_SOURCE=$(find /tmp/wanxiang-build-tools-x64 -type f -name source.properties -print -quit | xargs -r dirname); test -f "$BUILD_SOURCE/lib/d8.jar"; mv "$BUILD_SOURCE" "$COMPAT_ROOT/android-sdk/build-tools/35.0.0"; chmod 755 "$COMPAT_ROOT/android-sdk/build-tools/35.0.0/aapt2" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf /tmp/wanxiang-build-tools-x64 /tmp/wanxiang-build-tools-35.zip

test -x /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/qemu-x86_64 && test -x /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/rootfs/bin/sh && test -x /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/jdk-17/bin/java && test -d /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/gradle-8.14.2/lib && test -f /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/android-sdk/platforms/android-34/android.jar && test -x /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/android-sdk/build-tools/35.0.0/aapt2 && test -x /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/flutter/bin/cache/dart-sdk/bin/dart && (test -f /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/rootfs/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 || test -f /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/rootfs/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2)
verifyCommand: test -x /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/qemu-x86_64 && test -x /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/rootfs/bin/sh && test -x /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/jdk-17/bin/java && test -x /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/android-sdk/build-tools/35.0.0/aapt2 && test -x /opt/wanxiang/compat/x86_64/flutter/bin/cache/dart-sdk/bin/dart && qemu-x86_64 --version
